title: Use mimalloc 0.1.48 (feature v3) as TermAl's global allocator, per Greg
outcome: TermAl builds and runs with mimalloc as its global allocator on Windows, Linux and macOS, with before/after memory measurements recorded; it is not presented as a proven fix for the 17:08Z crash, whose cause is investigated separately (w-e938ef8d73be).
acceptance: Cargo.toml adds exactly `mimalloc = { version = "0.1.48", features = ["v3"] }` and the binary declares it as `#[global_allocator]`; Cargo.lock is updated only for mimalloc and its own dependencies.

The change lands the normal way: a clean review pair and the full gate green on the landing input (which builds and tests it on Linux/DL560); Windows and macOS builds come from the next joint restart's cargo run on Central and the Mac, recorded at attestation.
